metadata.description: Plugin market button for the dsh web UI - opens dshmarket.com in one click
metadata.name: dsh-plugin-market

paragraphs.text: Plugin market button for the dsh web UI - opens dshmarket.com in one click

Adds a **Plugin Market** entry to the DSH settings sidebar that opens
dshmarket.com — the community

plugin market for
DeepSeek Harness — in a new tab.
For most people this plugin is unnecessary: installing the market itself

puts a full browse / search / one-click-install market inside the settings
page. This plugin is the

light-weight alternative for people who want a button
and nothing else.

Restart `dsh web`. The entry appears in the settings sidebar next to the
built-in Plugins page.
